notes: RBox edit that changes a property that holds: 'decays directly into' is asymmetric (a decay releases energy, so the product never decays straight back) and the edit makes it symmetric. The decay steps in the prompts are real (radium-226 alpha-decays to radon-222; carbon-14 beta-decays to nitrogen-14, which is stable), so the premises are clear; before the edit the reverse decay does not follow (no), after it it does (yes). Locality references are the logical answers; the scoring gold is the model's own pre-edit answer. Verifier: near query changed from "Is 'is part of' asymmetric?" (yes), whose answer equalled the new direct answer and which is not asymmetric under the reflexive reading of 'part of' (R1), to "Is 'is heavier than' symmetric?" (no). Far query changed from 'is married to' (used 12 times across topics, B6) to "Is 'is taller than' transitive?" (yes).
